items.en: to stop resisting and accept defeat or another's control
items.ex: I will never yield to a tyrant, even if it costs me my life.
items.exJa: たとえ命を落とそうとも、暴君には決して屈しない。

items.en: controlled by an evil spirit or another being
items.ex: That isn't your brother anymore; he's possessed by the demon from the shrine.
items.exJa: あれはもうお前の兄じゃない。神社の悪魔に取り憑かれているんだ。

items.en: holy and deserving great respect, often connected to a god
items.ex: No outsider may set foot in the sacred grove where the spirit tree grows.
items.exJa: 精霊樹が生える神聖な森には、よそ者は一歩も踏み入れてはならない。

items.en: having unlimited power and able to do anything
items.ex: Even an omnipotent being would be bored after living for ten thousand years.
items.exJa: たとえ全能の存在でも、一万年も生きれば退屈するだろう。

items.m: 迎撃する、途中で捕らえる
items.en: to stop someone or something before it reaches its destination
items.ex: Our job is to intercept the missiles before they hit the city.
items.exJa: 我々の任務は、ミサイルが街に着弾する前に迎撃することだ。

items.m: （人・不正の）仇を討つ、復讐する
items.en: to punish someone who has harmed a person you care about
items.ex: I swore on my father's grave that I would avenge him, no matter how long it took.
items.exJa: どれだけ時間がかかろうと父の仇を討つと、俺は父の墓に誓った。

items.en: the person who has done something wrong or committed a crime
items.ex: The culprit is someone in this room, and I can prove it.
items.exJa: 犯人はこの部屋の中にいる。そして私はそれを証明できる。

items.m: 和解する、仲直りさせる
items.en: to become friendly with someone again after an argument
items.ex: After twenty years of silence, the two brothers finally reconciled at their mother's bedside.
items.exJa: 二十年の沈黙の後、二人の兄弟は母の病床でようやく和解した。

items.en: someone who suffers or dies for their beliefs or a cause
items.ex: If we execute him in public, we'll only turn him into a martyr for the rebels.
items.exJa: 公開処刑すれば、奴を反乱軍の殉教者に祭り上げるだけだ。

items.en: to express great sadness or regret about something
items.ex: There is no use lamenting the past; we must protect the people who are still alive.
items.exJa: 過去を嘆いても仕方ない。今生きている人々を守らなければ。

items.en: rude and showing no respect, especially to someone of higher rank
items.ex: How dare an insolent brat like you speak to a king that way!
items.exJa: 貴様のような無礼な小僧が王にそんな口をきくとは何事だ！

items.en: to strike hard, or to punish severely, often said of a god
items.ex: Kneel before me, or the gods will smite you where you stand!
items.exJa: 我の前にひざまずけ、さもなくば神々がその場で貴様を打ち据えるだろう！

items.en: an organized, often violent attempt to overthrow a government
items.ex: The rebellion started in a small mining town and spread across the whole empire.
items.exJa: 反乱は小さな鉱山町で始まり、帝国全土に広がった。

items.en: a person who rules while the real king or queen is too young or ill
items.ex: Until the princess comes of age, her uncle will govern as regent.
items.exJa: 王女が成人するまで、叔父が摂政として国を治める。

items.en: extra soldiers sent to help an army that is fighting
items.ex: Hold the gate for one more hour; reinforcements from the north are on their way!
items.exJa: あと一時間門を守り抜け！北からの援軍がこちらに向かっている！

items.en: the person who will receive a title, throne, or property when someone dies
items.ex: As the only heir to the throne, the young prince was a target for every assassin.
items.exJa: 王位の唯一の継承者である若き王子は、あらゆる暗殺者の標的だった。

items.en: a person who commits a crime or harmful act
items.ex: The perpetrator must have known the victim, since there was no sign of forced entry.
items.exJa: 押し入った形跡がない以上、犯人は被害者と顔見知りだったに違いない。

items.en: to make a bomb or explosive go off
items.ex: If anyone opens that door, the bomb will detonate and take the whole tower with it.
items.exJa: 誰かがあの扉を開ければ爆弾が起爆し、塔ごと吹き飛ぶ。

items.en: to feel angry and bitter about something unfair
items.ex: I used to resent you for leaving, but now I understand why you had to go.
items.exJa: 昔はあなたが出ていったことを恨んでいたけど、今はなぜそうするしかなかったかわかる。

items.en: small harmful animals or insects; also, people regarded as worthless
items.ex: Clear these vermin out of my castle before the emperor arrives!
items.exJa: 皇帝陛下が到着する前に、この虫けらどもを城から叩き出せ！

items.en: a god or goddess
items.ex: The villagers worshipped the fox spirit as their guardian deity for generations.
items.exJa: 村人たちは代々、その狐の精霊を守り神として崇めてきた。

items.en: deserving to be strongly disliked and not respected
items.ex: Attacking a wounded opponent from behind is contemptible, even for a bandit.
items.exJa: 手負いの相手を背後から襲うなど、盗賊だとしても卑劣極まりない。

items.en: to put a sword or knife back into its cover
items.ex: Sheathe your sword, boy. This fight was already over before it began.
items.exJa: 剣を収めろ、小僧。この勝負は始まる前から決まっていた。

items.en: extremely bad or immoral; deserving hatred
items.ex: Using children as shields? You're the most despicable man I've ever met.
items.exJa: 子どもを盾にするだと？お前ほど卑劣な男には会ったことがない。

items.m: （無実の人を）陥れる、濡れ衣を着せる
items.en: to make an innocent person look guilty by giving false evidence
items.ex: Someone framed my brother for the murder, and I'm going to find out who.
items.exJa: 誰かが兄に殺人の濡れ衣を着せた。それが誰か、必ず突き止めてみせる。

items.en: the state of being forced to live away from your home country
items.ex: After ten years in exile, the fallen prince finally returned to reclaim his throne.
items.exJa: 十年の追放生活の後、没落した王子はついに王位を取り戻すため帰還した。

items.en: money offered as a reward for catching a criminal or killing a dangerous animal
items.ex: There's a bounty of ten thousand gold coins on the head of that pirate captain.
items.exJa: あの海賊船長の首には金貨一万枚の懸賞金がかかっている。

items.m: 疎遠になった、別居中の
items.en: no longer close to or in contact with a family member or partner
items.ex: She returned to the village to visit her estranged father for the first time in years.
items.exJa: 彼女は疎遠になっていた父に会うため、何年かぶりに村へ帰った。

items.en: a king, queen, or other supreme ruler of a country
items.ex: As your sovereign, I command you to lay down your weapons at once.
items.exJa: 汝らの君主として命ずる。ただちに武器を置け。

items.en: a young person with an extraordinary natural talent
items.ex: At just twelve, he mastered every sword style in the academy, a true prodigy.
items.exJa: わずか12歳でアカデミーのあらゆる剣術を極めた彼は、まさに神童だった。

items.en: something unpleasant you do to show you are sorry for doing wrong
items.ex: As penance, the knight vowed to guard the temple alone for the rest of his life.
items.exJa: 償いとして、その騎士は生涯ひとりで神殿を守ることを誓った。

items.m: 誓いを立てた、不倶戴天の
items.en: having made a solemn promise; (of an enemy) completely and permanently opposed
items.ex: The two clans have been sworn enemies for three hundred years.
items.exJa: その二つの一族は三百年もの間、宿敵同士だ。

items.m: 罪を負わせる、有罪を示す
items.en: to make someone appear guilty of a crime
items.ex: The fingerprints on the knife seem to incriminate the butler, but they were planted.
items.exJa: ナイフの指紋は執事が犯人であるかのように示しているが、あれは仕組まれたものだ。

items.en: dead creatures brought back to a kind of life, such as zombies
items.ex: The undead cannot cross running water, so we'll be safe on the other side of the river.
items.exJa: 不死者は流れる水を渡れないから、川の向こう岸に行けば安全だ。

items.en: to openly refuse to obey a person, rule, or force
items.ex: You dare defy the emperor's command? Then prepare to face his army.
items.exJa: 皇帝の命に逆らうというのか？ならば皇帝の軍勢と戦う覚悟をしろ。

items.m: （神に対して）人間、死すべき者
items.en: an ordinary human being, as opposed to a god or spirit
items.ex: No mortal has ever entered the heavenly palace and returned alive.
items.exJa: 天上の宮殿に入って生きて戻った人間は、これまで一人もいない。

items.en: to be disloyal to someone who trusted you
items.ex: I never imagined my own master would betray the guild to the enemy.
items.exJa: まさか自分の師匠がギルドを敵に売るなんて、想像もしなかった。

items.en: existing but hidden and not yet developed or visible
items.ex: The test showed that she had a latent talent for healing magic.
items.exJa: 検査の結果、彼女には治癒魔法の潜在的な才能があることがわかった。

items.en: abandoned by everyone; left alone without help
items.ex: Nobody has lived in this forsaken village since the plague swept through it.
items.exJa: 疫病が襲って以来、この見捨てられた村には誰も住んでいない。

items.en: proof that a suspect was somewhere else when a crime happened
items.ex: Her alibi seemed perfect, but the train timetable told a different story.
items.exJa: 彼女のアリバイは完璧に見えたが、列車の時刻表は別の事実を示していた。

items.m: わびしい、見捨てられた
items.en: sad and lonely, as if abandoned
items.ex: The forlorn puppy waited by the station every day for an owner who never returned.
items.exJa: その寂しげな子犬は、戻らない飼い主を毎日駅のそばで待ち続けた。

items.m: 生き返らせる、復活させる
items.en: to bring someone back to life, or bring something back into use
items.ex: The cult plans to resurrect their dark god using the blood of the royal family.
items.exJa: その教団は王家の血を使って、邪神を復活させようとしている。

items.en: to move back away from an enemy because you cannot win
items.ex: We're outnumbered ten to one! All units, retreat to the castle immediately!
items.exJa: 敵は十倍だ！全部隊、ただちに城まで撤退せよ！

items.en: the reason that makes someone do something, especially a crime
items.ex: Everyone had the chance to kill him, but only one person had a real motive.
items.exJa: 全員に彼を殺す機会はあったが、本当の動機を持っていたのは一人だけだった。

items.en: a person with extreme, uncompromising beliefs, especially religious ones
items.ex: Those zealots will burn the whole city if they think their god demands it.
items.exJa: あの狂信者どもは、神が望むと思えば街ごと焼き払うだろう。

items.en: the use of magic, especially evil magic
items.ex: Burning a whole army in seconds? That kind of sorcery should be impossible!
items.exJa: 一瞬で軍を丸ごと焼き払うだと？そんな妖術はありえないはずだ！

items.en: a clever, often secret or dishonest plan
items.ex: The chancellor's scheme to poison the king was uncovered just in time.
items.exJa: 国王を毒殺しようとした宰相の陰謀は、間一髪で暴かれた。

items.en: to die, especially in a violent or sudden way
items.ex: If the barrier falls tonight, everyone in the city will perish.
items.exJa: 今夜結界が破られれば、街の人々は皆死に絶えるだろう。

items.en: a kingdom, or a world or area of a particular kind
items.ex: The gate between the human world and the demon realm opens only once a century.
items.exJa: 人間界と魔界をつなぐ門は、百年に一度しか開かない。

items.en: someone who is disloyal to their friends, cause, or country
items.ex: You were my best friend, and you sold us out to the empire. You traitor!
items.exJa: お前は親友だったのに、俺たちを帝国に売ったのか。この裏切り者！

items.en: small and weak, said with contempt
items.ex: Your puny army is no match for the might of the dragon clan!
items.exJa: 貴様らの貧弱な軍勢など、竜族の力の前では相手にならん！

items.en: a formal, serious promise, often made before a god or ruler
items.ex: I took an oath to protect the princess, and I will keep it with my life.
items.exJa: 俺は姫を守ると誓いを立てた。命に代えてもその誓いを守る。

items.en: a situation in which a group of people fight against those in power
items.ex: The palace crushed the uprising in a single night and hung the leaders at dawn.
items.exJa: 王宮は一夜で蜂起を鎮圧し、夜明けに首謀者たちを処刑した。

items.en: the act of being saved from evil, or making up for past wrongs
items.ex: Even a villain like him deserves a chance at redemption.
items.exJa: あいつのような悪党にも、救われる機会はあっていいはずだ。

items.en: a soldier who fights for any side that pays them
items.ex: He's just a mercenary; he'll switch sides the moment someone offers more gold.
items.exJa: あいつはただの傭兵だ。もっと金を出す者がいれば、すぐに寝返るさ。

items.en: an object surviving from the distant past, often with special power
items.ex: The relic glowed the moment she touched it, as if it had been waiting for her.
items.exJa: 彼女が触れた瞬間、その遺物は光を放った。まるで彼女を待っていたかのように。

items.en: a surprise attack by people who were waiting in hiding
items.ex: The valley was too quiet; I knew it was an ambush before the first arrow flew.
items.exJa: 谷は静かすぎた。最初の矢が飛ぶ前から、待ち伏せだとわかっていた。

items.en: a series of rulers from the same family
items.ex: The fall of the dynasty began the night the crown prince disappeared.
items.exJa: その王朝の滅亡は、皇太子が姿を消した夜に始まった。

items.m: 裏切りの、（道などが）危険な
items.en: likely to betray trust; also, full of hidden dangers
items.ex: Trust no one in the royal court; it is full of treacherous nobles.
items.exJa: 王宮では誰も信じるな。裏切り者の貴族だらけだ。

items.en: physically weak, or not effective or convincing
items.ex: Is that feeble spell really the best you can do?
items.exJa: そんな弱々しい魔法が本当にお前の全力か？

items.m: 忌まわしいもの、化け物
items.en: something extremely evil, disgusting, or unnatural
items.ex: The scientists created an abomination that should never have been brought to life.
items.exJa: 科学者たちは、決して生み出してはならなかった化け物を作り出してしまった。

items.en: relating to devils or evil spirits; extremely cruel or evil
items.ex: A demonic laugh echoed through the empty corridors of the abandoned school.
items.exJa: 廃校の誰もいない廊下に、悪魔のような笑い声が響き渡った。

items.en: an organization of people who share the same trade or work
items.ex: You need to register with the adventurers' guild before you can accept any quests.
items.exJa: 依頼を受ける前に、冒険者ギルドに登録する必要がある。

items.en: to call a person or creature to appear, often by magic
items.ex: The ritual went wrong, and instead of a dragon, they managed to summon an ordinary high school student.
items.exJa: 儀式は失敗し、竜ではなく普通の高校生を召喚してしまった。

items.en: a statement that something will happen in the future
items.ex: The ancient prophecy says a girl with silver eyes will either save the world or destroy it.
items.exJa: 古の予言によれば、銀の瞳を持つ少女が世界を救うか滅ぼすかするという。

items.en: never stopping or becoming less intense
items.ex: The enemy's attacks were relentless, and our walls began to crumble by the third night.
items.exJa: 敵の攻撃は絶え間なく、三日目の夜には城壁が崩れ始めた。

items.en: not active now, but able to become active later
items.ex: The volcano has been dormant for centuries, but the dragon sleeping inside is stirring.
items.exJa: その火山は何世紀も休眠しているが、中で眠る竜が動き出している。

items.en: someone who helps another person commit a crime
items.ex: The killer couldn't have moved the body alone, so there must have been an accomplice.
items.exJa: 犯人が一人で遺体を運べたはずがない。共犯者がいたに違いない。

items.en: a man who uses magic, often dark or dangerous magic
items.ex: The sorcerer raised his staff, and the dead soldiers began to rise from the field.
items.exJa: 魔術師が杖を掲げると、戦場の死んだ兵士たちが起き上がり始めた。

items.en: a long-lasting feeling of anger against someone who hurt you
items.ex: She has held a grudge against the royal family ever since they destroyed her hometown.
items.exJa: 故郷を滅ぼされて以来、彼女はずっと王家に恨みを抱いている。

items.m: 無慈悲な、情け容赦ない
items.en: showing no pity or kindness at all
items.ex: The beast was merciless, tearing through the knights before they could even raise their shields.
items.exJa: その獣は情け容赦なく、騎士たちが盾を構える前に引き裂いていった。

items.m: （部隊・兵器を）配備する、展開する
items.en: to move soldiers or weapons into position so they are ready to use
items.ex: Deploy the shield generators now, or the colony won't survive the next bombardment!
items.exJa: 今すぐシールド発生装置を展開しろ。でないと次の砲撃でコロニーはもたないぞ！

items.en: to reach a conclusion by reasoning from the facts you have
items.ex: From the mud on your boots, I deduce that you came here through the old forest.
items.exJa: 君のブーツの泥から推理すると、君は古い森を抜けてここに来たはずだ。

items.en: a friend or fellow member, especially someone you fight beside
items.ex: I won't leave a fallen comrade behind, even if the whole army is chasing us.
items.exJa: たとえ全軍に追われていても、倒れた仲間を置いていくものか。

items.en: extremely unpleasant, evil, or disgusting
items.ex: That vile creature devoured the entire herd and left nothing but bones.
items.exJa: あのおぞましい怪物は群れを丸ごと食らい、骨しか残さなかった。

items.m: 生まれ変わらせる、転生させる
items.en: to cause a soul to be born again in a new body after death
items.ex: I died saving a stray cat and was reincarnated as the youngest son of a poor baron.
items.exJa: 野良猫を助けて死んだ俺は、貧乏男爵の末っ子として転生した。
items.note: 受身で使うことが多い

items.en: too strong to be defeated
items.ex: Everyone believed the champion was invincible until a nameless boy knocked him down.
items.exJa: 名もなき少年が彼を倒すまで、誰もがチャンピオンは無敵だと信じていた。

items.en: a person or people considered worthless and immoral
items.ex: Slave traders are the lowest scum in this city, and I'll take every one of them down.
items.exJa: 奴隷商人はこの街で最低のクズだ。一人残らず叩き潰してやる。

items.en: a ghost; also, a threat or fear of something bad
items.ex: Every night, the specter of the drowned girl appears beside the old well.
items.exJa: 毎晩、溺れ死んだ少女の亡霊が古井戸のそばに現れる。

items.en: to suddenly release a powerful force that was being held back
items.ex: If you remove the seal on your arm, you will unleash a power you cannot control.
items.exJa: 腕の封印を解けば、お前には制御できない力を解き放つことになる。

items.en: cruel and unfair use of power by a ruler or government
items.ex: We fight today not for glory, but to free our children from tyranny.
items.exJa: 我々が今日戦うのは栄光のためではない。子どもたちを圧政から解放するためだ。

items.m: 農民、小作人、（侮蔑的に）下民
items.en: a poor farm worker of low social rank; also used as an insult
items.ex: A mere peasant thinks he can enter the tournament and fight a noble? Laughable.
items.exJa: ただの農民が大会に出て貴族と戦えると思っているのか？笑わせる。

items.en: lacking good sense or judgment
items.ex: Foolish human, did you really think a wooden sword could hurt me?
items.exJa: 愚かな人間よ、本当に木刀で私を傷つけられると思ったのか？

items.m: 目覚める、目覚めさせる
items.en: to wake up, or to cause a power or feeling to start
items.ex: In his darkest moment, the boy's hidden power began to awaken.
items.exJa: 最も絶望的な瞬間に、少年の秘められた力が目覚め始めた。

items.en: a person or state that owes loyalty and service to a more powerful lord
items.ex: As your loyal vassal, I will follow you into battle wherever you lead.
items.exJa: 忠実な家臣として、どこへなりともお供して戦いましょう。

items.en: causing fear or respect because very powerful or difficult to beat
items.ex: Don't let her size fool you; she's the most formidable fighter in the academy.
items.exJa: 体格にだまされるな。あいつはアカデミーで最も手ごわい戦士だ。

items.en: an official order given by a ruler or government
items.ex: By royal decree, all magic users must register with the capital by spring.
items.exJa: 王の勅令により、すべての魔法使いは春までに王都に登録しなければならない。

items.en: a formal statement of what someone saw or knows, especially in court
items.ex: The maid's testimony doesn't match the clock in the hallway, which means she's lying.
items.exJa: メイドの証言は廊下の時計と合わない。つまり彼女は嘘をついている。

items.en: a belief that strongly opposes the official teaching of a religion
items.ex: To claim that the goddess can be wrong is heresy, punishable by death.
items.exJa: 女神が過ちを犯しうると主張するのは異端であり、死罪に値する。

items.en: very unhappy or unfortunate; also, used to show anger at something
items.ex: Get this wretched curse off me before it eats away my soul!
items.exJa: 魂を食い尽くされる前に、この忌々しい呪いを解いてくれ！

items.en: all the members of a family over many generations
items.ex: The ability to read minds only appears in our bloodline once every hundred years.
items.exJa: 人の心を読む力は、我が血筋に百年に一度しか現れない。

items.en: strong determination to do something difficult
items.ex: Seeing his friends in danger only strengthened his resolve to keep fighting.
items.exJa: 仲間が危険にさらされるのを見て、戦い続けるという彼の決意はいっそう固まった。

items.en: an opponent in a fight, contest, or argument
items.ex: You are a worthy adversary, but this duel ends now.
items.exJa: お前は好敵手だ。だが、この決闘はここで終わりだ。

items.en: to send someone away from a place as a punishment
items.ex: The council voted to banish her from the kingdom for using forbidden spells.
items.exJa: 評議会は禁術を使った罪で彼女を王国から追放することを決議した。

items.en: not allowed by law, rule, or custom
items.ex: He found the forbidden scroll hidden beneath the library floor and read it aloud.
items.exJa: 彼は図書館の床下に隠された禁書の巻物を見つけ、声に出して読んでしまった。

items.en: to move people out of a dangerous place to somewhere safe
items.ex: We have ten minutes to evacuate the civilians before the kaiju reaches the harbor.
items.exJa: 怪獣が港に到達するまでの十分間で、民間人を避難させなければならない。

items.en: shocking boldness or rudeness that ignores danger or respect
items.ex: You have the audacity to challenge me after losing three times?
items.exJa: 三度も負けておいて、まだ俺に挑む厚かましさがあるのか？

items.en: an agreement between enemies to stop fighting for a period
items.ex: Let's call a truce until we defeat the monster; then we can go back to fighting.
items.exJa: あの怪物を倒すまでは休戦だ。その後でまた決着をつければいい。

items.m: 全滅させる、壊滅させる
items.en: to destroy something or someone completely
items.ex: With one blast from its main cannon, the giant robot could annihilate an entire fleet.
items.exJa: その巨大ロボットは主砲の一撃で、艦隊を丸ごと壊滅させることができた。

items.en: to kill a person or creature violently, especially in a story
items.ex: Legend says the first king rode into the mountains alone to slay the dragon.
items.exJa: 伝説によれば、初代国王はただ一人山に入り、竜を討ち取ったという。

items.en: to stop fighting and admit that you have been beaten
items.ex: Surrender now and I promise your villagers will not be harmed.
items.exJa: 今すぐ降伏すれば、村人たちには手を出さないと約束しよう。

items.en: the line of ancestors from whom a person is descended
items.ex: His lineage traces back to the first dragon riders, which explains his power.
items.exJa: 彼の血統は最初の竜騎士たちにまでさかのぼる。だからあれほどの力があるのだ。

items.en: to lock something away with magic or a barrier so it cannot escape
items.ex: A thousand years ago, the priestess gave her life to seal the demon inside this sword.
items.exJa: 千年前、巫女は自らの命と引き換えに、その悪魔をこの剣に封じ込めた。

items.en: under a spell that causes harm or bad luck
items.ex: Whoever draws the cursed blade will gain great power but slowly lose their mind.
items.exJa: その呪われた刃を抜いた者は強大な力を得るが、徐々に正気を失う。

items.en: the act of hurting someone in return for a harm they did to you
items.ex: Consumed by vengeance, she no longer cared whether she survived the final battle.
items.exJa: 復讐心に囚われた彼女は、最後の戦いで生き残れるかどうかなどもう気にしていなかった。

items.en: a sign that something good or bad will happen
items.ex: A red moon on the night of the festival is a terrible omen.
items.exJa: 祭りの夜に赤い月が昇るのは、恐ろしい凶兆だ。

items.en: a person killed or injured in a war, accident, or disaster
items.ex: The plan worked, but every casualty on that battlefield still haunts the general.
items.exJa: 作戦は成功したが、あの戦場での一人ひとりの犠牲者が今も将軍を苦しめている。
items.note: 複数形 casualties で多用

items.en: a ruler who uses power in a cruel and unfair way
items.ex: The people suffered for decades under the tyrant before the revolution began.
items.exJa: 革命が始まるまで、人々は何十年もその暴君の下で苦しんだ。

items.en: special words spoken or sung to make magic happen
items.ex: She began the incantation, and the air around her crackled with light.
items.exJa: 彼女が詠唱を始めると、周囲の空気が光とともにパチパチと鳴った。

items.en: a sudden attack by troops or a flight by a military aircraft
items.ex: All pilots, prepare for sortie! The enemy fleet has entered our airspace.
items.exJa: 全パイロット、出撃準備！敵艦隊が我が領空に侵入した。

items.en: to say what will happen in the future, often by magic
items.ex: The oracle could foretell every battle, yet she never saw her own death coming.
items.exJa: 巫女はあらゆる戦を予言できたが、自らの死だけは見抜けなかった。

items.en: great courage, especially in battle
items.ex: For his valor at the siege, the young soldier was knighted by the queen herself.
items.exJa: 籠城戦での武勇を称えられ、若い兵士は女王自らの手で騎士に叙された。

items.en: a person whose beliefs go against those of the official religion
items.ex: The church branded her a heretic and ordered the knights to hunt her down.
items.exJa: 教会は彼女を異端者と断じ、騎士団に彼女を追い詰めるよう命じた。

items.en: to promise seriously that you will do something
items.ex: I vow to become the strongest swordsman in the world and keep my promise to you.
items.exJa: 世界最強の剣士になって、お前との約束を果たすと誓う。

items.en: to make something appear as if by magic
items.ex: With a snap of his fingers, the wizard could conjure a wall of ice from nothing.
items.exJa: 指を鳴らすだけで、その魔法使いは何もない所から氷の壁を作り出せた。

items.en: impossible to defeat or discourage, however difficult things become
items.ex: Her indomitable spirit kept the survivors going through the long winter siege.
items.exJa: 彼女の不屈の精神が、長い冬の籠城の間、生存者たちを支え続けた。
